description: Star intrinsic ability templates. Registered as IAbilitySource via StarAbilitySource (PROJ-302). Keys are StarType enum names. Most star abilities are scope: system (radiation field, gravitational interference) — a pulsar affects every hex of the system. {"min": x, "max": y} ranges rolled at galaxy generation. Per PROJ-302 D7, hostile star systems (NEUTRON_STAR, BLACK_HOLE, BLUE_GIANT, RED_GIANT) have NO balance cap by design — players are expected to recognize and route around them.

MAIN_SEQUENCE.name: Main Sequence
MAIN_SEQUENCE.description: Stable middle-aged star; no significant intrinsic effects.

RED_GIANT.name: Red Giant
RED_GIANT.description: Bloated dying star; intense thermal radiation buffets the entire system.

BLUE_GIANT.name: Blue Giant
BLUE_GIANT.description: Hot, massive star; UV radiation degrades shields system-wide.

WHITE_DWARF.name: White Dwarf
WHITE_DWARF.description: Compact stellar remnant; mild gravitational perturbation.

NEUTRON_STAR.name: Neutron Star
NEUTRON_STAR.description: Compact stellar remnant; intense radiation field across the system.

BLACK_HOLE.name: Black Hole
BLACK_HOLE.description: Gravitational singularity; spacetime distortion cripples thrust and speed.
